title: Flat Earth "Science" -- Wrong, but not Stupid
summary: Sabine Hossenfelder explains what flat earthers believe and why, arguing that their reasoning is wrong but not stupid. She suggests scientists should take such believers more seriously.
why: Pointed to in discussions about engaging with fringe beliefs and distrust of institutions rather than dismissing people.

quote.text: I would point interested folks to an interesting video by Sabine Hossenfelder
